title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1979-11-25
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-8 => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: Master Cassettes [FOB, 60' from stage]  (Maxell UD XL II) 2 x Nakamichi CM-700 => Sony TC-D5 >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a solid 1979 show with standout Shakedown Street → Bertha, soaring Jack Straw, and superb Stella Blue/Deal moments.
ai_review.review: The tape is an outstanding audience (aud) capture – listeners praise its crystal‑clear instrument separation and subtle details like the Mind Left Body tease. Musically the concert is described as a tight, high‑energy performance with highlights such as Shakedown Street into Bertha, a powerful Jack Straw, and memorable renditions of Stella Blue, Deal and the teasing into Stella Blue.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers give 5‑star ratings, uniformly praising both the musical performance and the recording quality; the consensus is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Highly praised for superb instrument separation, crisp clarity, and subtle audible teases; recorded with high‑end mics (AT811) and noise reduction, delivering a clean, immersive sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a strong, nonstop energy from the opening through the close, with smooth transitions (e.g., Shakedown Street → Bertha) and effective jams that kept the momentum high all night.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh is highlighted as the main thruster, delivering a powerful low‑end drive especially on Jack Straw.
